entities.name: 2,4-Difluoronitrobenzoic acid
observations: Contains an aromatic nitro group, carboxylic acid, and two aryl fluorines.

entities.name: 2,4-Difluoroaminobenzoic acid
observations: The product retains the carboxylic acid and both fluorines while bearing a primary aromatic amine.

entities.name: Aromatic nitro reduction
observations: Net transformation is reduction of an aryl nitro group to an aryl primary amine: Ar-NO2 to Ar-NH2.
The transformation is not ester hydrolysis, deprotection, or aryl fluoride substitution.

entities.name: H2/Pd catalytic hydrogenation
observations: Strongest matching record uses H2 with Pd; Pd/C is a standard practical form of this reagent system.
Alcoholic solvent is plausible, but the exact solvent and pressure are not established by the supplied evidence.

entities.name: Ammonium acetate reduction
observations: A related matching record uses ammonium acetate-based conditions, consistent with reduction of the aromatic nitro group.
The exact co-reductant or catalyst is not specified in the supplied evidence.
